quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 1,473,966,074.80, up 47.56%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 176,672,911.07, up 163.76%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 139,948,940.52, up 190.11%; operating cash flow RMB 231,246,134.47, up 23.59%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 265,221,230.78, Q2 RMB 331,426,252.78, Q3 RMB 401,760,502.34, Q4 RMB 475,558,088.90; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 10,844,779.88, Q2 RMB 41,024,912.76, Q3 RMB 63,439,087.88, Q4 RMB 61,364,130.55. The company attributes revenue growth to expanding domestic and overseas markets, new customers and the acquisition of 100% of Wuhan Jiepu (now Wuhan Guangku Technology, optical-component manufacturing and subsystem solutions), consolidated from 31 July 2025, which contributed RMB 9,826.70 ten-thousand of revenue in August-December 2025.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Segments (annual report): optical communication devices revenue RMB 786,150,258.99 in 2025, up 100.37%, 53.34% of revenue, gross margin 33.48% (down 1.51 points); fiber laser devices RMB 497,886,821.00, up 17.37%, gross margin 39.96%; lidar light-source modules and devices RMB 101,208,091.10, down 27.53%, gross margin 12.00% (the company cites fewer orders); other RMB 88,720,903.71, up 107.99%. Overseas revenue RMB 736,321,386.06, 49.96% of revenue, up 86.23%, overseas gross margin 41.54%; domestic RMB 737,644,688.74, up 22.23%. The company attributes the optical communication output and sales growth to surging data-center demand. Subsidiaries: Milan unit (lithium niobate modulator chips and devices) revenue RMB 4,173.93 ten-thousand with a net loss of RMB -4,609.76 ten-thousand; Zhuhai Jiahua Weijie (high-end fiber connection and micro-optic connection products) revenue RMB 33,012.10 ten-thousand, net profit RMB 2,525.95 ten-thousand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFLN modulator status (annual report, raised-fund project notes): TFLN driver modulator CDM chips for long-haul coherent transmission ship in volume to a leading optical communication equipment company; TFLN CDM modules passed verification at a leading equipment company and are in small-batch production and shipment; CDM chips for data-center DCI coherent use received customer verification orders and are sampling; PAM-4 TFLN modulator chips for data-center and AI-cluster high-speed interconnect are in verification sampling, with downstream customer development and verification delayed; the AM70 TFLN modulator for microwave photonics ships in small batches. Because downstream lithium niobate modulator orders fell short of expectations, the project's cumulative capacity utilisation to 31 December 2025 was below the forecast and its 2025 net profit missed the expected level. The company says that as optical modules move from 800G to 1.6T and 3.2T, TFLN modulators are expected to gain share rapidly.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Projects (annual report): the lithium niobate high-speed modulator chip R&D and industrialisation project (investment RMB 5.85 hundred million) had its ready-for-use date extended to 30 November 2026; its civil works (budget RMB 220,000,000.00) were transferred to fixed assets in 2025 (RMB 86,835,250.24), which cut construction in progress 56.80% to RMB 90,077,002.12. The Thailand production base project (investment RMB 2.15 hundred million; construction budget RMB 81,193,721.99, 95.30% complete) passed ISO9001 certification, completed on-site audits of three products for an important customer, passed PCN certification, started small-batch trial production and put one pigtail product into volume production; installation of the second batch of core automation equipment was expected to finish in Q1 2026, and the raised-fund project was closed as implemented according to plan.
quarterly_data.figure: lithium niobate chip project ready-for-use date 30 November 2026; Thailand base 95.30% complete

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New optical communication products released in 2025 (annual report) include: two-dimensional multichannel fiber arrays for all-optical switches and a multichannel 2D FAU series for all-optical switches (OCS), a WDM module for CPO, an 800G silicon-photonics integrated inline isolator, a 1.6T high-speed network optical circulator, a detachable pluggable optical connector for CPO, a 1.6T optical transceiver engine, integrated optical interconnect for CPO, a single-lane 200G PAM4 DR48 LPO modulator chip and a single-lane 400G PAM4 DR4 modulator chip. R&D projects at the sample stage include 2D FAU for OCS, a CPO optical engine (high-density multichannel fiber interface) and 1.6T optical transceiver engine components.
quarterly_data.figure: single-lane 200G and 400G PAM4 modulator chips; 1.6T optical transceiver engine

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company plan): keep high R&D intensity, focusing on TFLN modulators and photonic integration and completing fiber-array products for CPO and OCS; strive to complete the major asset restructuring to acquire Suzhou Anjiexun and integrate its capacity, patents, customers and supply chain to strengthen supply of high-speed optical module core components; upgrade capacity at the Zhuhai and Wuhan bases and push automation and precision machining at the Thailand base to secure overseas order delivery; improve lithium niobate modulator chip process yield and speed up verification with leading domestic and overseas customers in data center, AI compute and high-speed optical communication.
